events.text: At the closing gate of {sr_realm}, {npc} lifts the find out of your pack while you are watching for an ambush that does not come, and is three steps away before you understand. {He} does not run. {He} turns and looks at you, and {his} face is the worst of it: not ashamed, only sorry that it had to be you.

choices.text: Ask {him} why

mem.note: took the find from me at the gate of the sealed realm

effects.log: {He} says something about debts, about a chance that comes once. Then the mist closes between you.

choices.text: Swear you will remember

mem.note: robbed me at the gate of the sealed realm and heard my oath

effects.log: You say it quietly. {He} hears it. That is enough, for now.

choices.text: Let {him} go

mem.note: was let go after robbing me at the gate of the sealed realm

effects.log: You open your hands. {He} stares, nods once, and goes. You do not know which of you has lost more.

events.text: {npc} was meant to carry the find to the quay while you held the gate. Instead there is a rope-ladder at the cliff-edge, a spar of cloud-wood, and a small hand-drawn map you can read from here: it shows a different isle, and a different buyer. {npc} is already a speck on the wind.

choices.text: Signal the quay to watch the skies

mem.note: ran off with the find from the sealed realm

effects.log: A sky-ferry swings out. It is a clean pursuit, and you are not sure you want it to succeed.

choices.text: Let the wind decide

mem.note: ran off with the find, and was waved goodbye

effects.log: You wave at the speck, once, and turn back to the gate. The wind is not on your side. It never is.

events.text: Of course {npc} is here. You see {him} across a clearing in {sr_realm}, as you always see {him}, at the worst moment: just as you reach for a find at the base of a fallen pillar. {He} sees it too. You both stop. You were born the same night. You know how this goes.

choices.text: Fight {him} for it

mem.note: beat me to a find in the sealed realm

ok.log: You reach the pillar first and hold it. {He} wipes {his} mouth, nods, and goes. Next time, the nod says.

mem.note: lost a find to me in the sealed realm

fail.log: {He} is a breath faster. {He} holds up the find, salutes you with it, and is gone into the mist.

choices.text: Let {him} take it

mem.note: let me take a find in the sealed realm

effects.log: {He} hesitates, suspicious, then takes it. At the edge of the clearing {he} looks back, as if trying to work out what you have won.

choices.text: Race {him} for it

mem.note: outran me to a find in the sealed realm

ok.log: You are over the pillar and gone before {he} moves. {His} curse follows you a long way.

mem.note: lost a race to me in the sealed realm

fail.log: {He} is there first, laughing, the find held over {his} head.

events.text: You stop for breath on a ledge of {sr_realm} and find {npc} already there, sitting with {his} back to the cliff and {his} knees up, looking oddly young. Neither of you speaks for some time. The realm is quiet around you both. At last {he} says: you are not what I expected, when we were small.

choices.text: Say the same of {him}

mem.note: sat with me on a ledge in the sealed realm and spoke plainly

effects.log: {He} laughs, short and surprised. For a while you share the ledge like old soldiers, and almost like friends.

choices.text: Get up and go on

mem.note: walked off from the ledge in the sealed realm

effects.log: {He} watches you leave. The ledge is quite cold without {him}, and you know it, and keep walking.

events.text: At the heart of {sr_realm}, with the prize between you and no one else about, {npc} lowers {his} blade first. A great realm calls for a great answer, {he} says, and it must not be settled by two fools on a stair. {He} suggests, with a cold smile, that you each carry half, and settle the rest at home. It is a sensible offer. That is what makes it suspicious.

choices.text: Accept, and watch {his} hands

mem.note: split a great find with me in the sealed realm

effects.log: The half-find is warm in your pack. {He} keeps to the bargain. You are unsettled by how much you wanted it not to.

choices.text: Refuse, and strike first

mem.note: took a great find from me in the sealed realm

ok.log: It is quick and unlovely. {He} yields the whole find with a look like a closed door.

mem.note: lost a great find to me in the sealed realm

fail.log: {He} was ready. You are sat down, smartly, and the find is borne off under {his} arm.

events.text: {npc} stands at the quay of {sr_realm} in a borrowed travelling robe, too big in the shoulders, trying to look as if {he} is not frightened. You are past the barrier's limit now. All you can do is send {him} in with everything you know, and wait for the season to end.

choices.text: Teach {him} the dangers all night

mem.note: came out of the sealed realm with a find, because of what I was taught

ok.log: {npc} comes out at the season's end thinner and browner and grinning, with a pouch of spirit-dust and a story {he} will tell for the rest of {his} life.

mem.note: came back hurt from the sealed realm I was sent into

fail.log: {npc} comes out on a stretcher, with a broken arm and a long scar along {his} jaw. {He} found nothing. {He} is alive. You hold on to that.

choices.text: Give {him} your old sword and your blessing

mem.note: carried my elder's sword through the sealed realm

ok.log: The sword comes back notched, with {npc} behind it, and {his} first real find tied to the hilt.

mem.note: broke the sword I was given in the sealed realm

fail.log: {npc} limps out at the end with the sword in two pieces and {his} pride in more. {He} will heal. The sword will not.

events.text: The barrier has taken its measure of you and found you too strong to enter, and so {npc} goes in your place. {He} stops at the quay with a pack on {his} back and asks, very evenly, whether you are sure. You are not. It is, after all, {his} life. The mist stirs, and waits for an answer.

choices.text: Say yes, and mean it

mem.note: sent me into the sealed realm and said they were sure

effects.log: {He} nods, shoulders the pack and goes. The mist closes on {him} like a hand. You count the days.

choices.text: Say no, and hear {him} out

mem.note: listened before sending me into the sealed realm

effects.log: {He} talks for an hour. You are still not sure. But {he} goes in with a better plan than {he} came with.

events.text: A crowd of disciples waits at the barrier of {sr_realm}, and {npc} is somewhere in the middle of it, taller than you remember and holding a lantern that is clearly not {his}. Every elder who ever sent a pupil in is watching you now, from the corners of their eyes, to see how you do it.

choices.text: Hand {him} a talisman and say little

mem.note: gave me a talisman and let me go into the sealed realm

effects.log: It is a plain bit of jade. {He} turns it over, then tucks it into {his} sleeve as if it were made of glass.

choices.text: Give {him} a list of what to avoid

mem.note: gave me a list for the sealed realm

effects.log: {He} reads it twice. {He} brings it back at the end, creased, with three lines crossed out and one added.

events.text: Years after you came out of the sealed realm, you still dream of it some nights: the light, the thin cold air, the guardian's eyes. You wake with your hand on your sword and the smell of another place in your nose. The dreams are not nightmares, exactly. They feel more like an invitation.

choices.text: Rise and cultivate

effects.log: You sit in the moon-pavilion until dawn. The dream fades. The invitation does not.

choices.text: Write the dream down

effects.log: You fill three pages. Reading them in daylight, you find a thing you did not know you had noticed.

events.text: A messenger from the Archive brings you a slip of rice-paper: the Houses have recorded who came out of the last opening, and in what order. Your name is on the list. It sits quietly near the middle, between two names you recognise and one you do not. It is, you find, a very odd feeling to be written down.

choices.text: Ask who the stranger was

effects.log: The messenger does not know. But the question travels, and a year later you receive an answer.

choices.text: Pin the slip above your desk

effects.log: It looks small there. But you glance at it often, and it stands for something.

events.text: You have not forgotten the gate of the sealed realm, nor the hand that took the find from your pack. Lately you have been hearing the name in market-gossip: richer, grander, a little more careful. It is no more than a rumour. But you notice that you have started to keep your back to the wall in tea-houses again.

choices.text: Send word that you remember, and forgive

effects.log: The reply comes in a single line of good brush-work. It is not an apology, but it is close.

choices.text: Add the name to the list you do not discuss

effects.log: A ledger of grievances is a small, private, comfortable thing, and it grows quietly.

events.text: A story is told in the Archive that someone once broke the guardian of a great sealed realm and walked out with the find. The tellers stop short of the name, at which they look at their cups. A young scribe, new to the Isles, asks if it is true. You have been waiting a long time for someone to ask.

choices.text: Tell the story as it happened

effects.log: You tell it plainly, without ornament. The scribe is quiet at the end, and then writes it down.

choices.text: Smile, and let the tellers tell it

effects.log: Stories grow better untended. By next year there are three versions, and yours is the least exciting.

events.text: The gate of {sr_realm} lets you out the way a tide lets go of a shell. One breath you are in the long light, the next on the damp stone of the quay with the mist already sealing at your back. You were not seen to slip out. You are a little thinner, and your hands are not quite steady, and nobody will ever know.

choices.text: Walk home by the long way

effects.log: You take the unlit lanes. By the time you arrive the lamps are being trimmed, and you are no more than a passer-by.

choices.text: Sit on the quay and breathe

effects.log: The barrier hums gently behind you, like a closed book. An old gate-keeper nods at you, and says nothing.

events.text: You come out of {sr_realm} with the find held close, in the grey of the gate, and every party on the quay turns to look. Nobody moves. Nobody needs to. In the silence you carry what you carry, and you feel the weight of every pair of eyes as a hand on your shoulder.

choices.text: Walk through the crowd with your head up

effects.log: They part. Some bow. You do not slow down, and do not look back.

choices.text: Thank the gate-keeper aloud

effects.log: It is a small courtesy and the crowd remembers it. They remember a good deal, in the Isles.
